correctness.rationale: Every 2D F2 image U has exactly three nonzero vectors; the two smallest give a unique canonical ordered basis, producing 651 image planes. Every onto rank-two map is uniquely P(z)=α(z)u+β(z)v for ordered independent nonzero dual masks α≠β, 63·62=3906 per image, 2,542,806 total. Rota–Baxter identity is bilinear in (x,y) so its 36 ordered basis pairs suffice. An independently written and EXECUTED C++ exhaustive bit-matrix implementation processed all 2,542,806 maps and reproduced exactly 652 valid, 100 closed image planes, all six histogram counts and two exceptional fibers. For the two 210-fiber square-zero ideals, surjections A/U→U count (2^4−1)(2^4−2)=210 and explain concentration. This is a COMPLETE finite proof for the stated exact domain; no claims for other q or larger matrices.
